title: (60 Years) to Board: June 2014
columns:
Education and Professional Background:
Lawrence holds a Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting)
degree from Kenyatta University and is a member of the
Institute of Certified Public Accountants of Kenya (CPA-K).
He joined the KCB Group Board in May 2018 and Chaired
the Audit Committee until July 2020.
He has over 10 years’ experience in Board leadership and
has served as a non-executive director of Kenya Seed
Company where he chaired the Audit Committee and
previously as Chairman of Simlaw Seeds Company Limited.
